items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: Then Patti, I met Patti Page later, and she told me how much she liked it.

ctx.x: did it and did the double voices and everything on it which was beautiful when she did it, you know. There's no question about that.

And, and so he told me the whole story right there, sitting there, and I said what. Then Patti, I met Patti Page later, and she told me how much she liked it. And, she used to give me a little credit on it.
But, there it was being played on the radio before my tune started getting on a little. Then, they covered it up with hers then.
